name: Miyamoto Uran
source:
An outgoing and cheerful young woman. She works for "Girls Magazine" and is always out for new scoops. Can this pretty face hide something dangerous? 

[Based on the [url=https://adeltaz1.wixsite.com/uuultrac/blank-18]official website[/url]] 

[Spoiler]She's a "futanari" that's female up top and male down below. 

I'm sure everyone questions their gender at one time or another, but in Miyamoto's case, she considers herself lucky that she can be with both women and men. 

She has two younger brothers aged 12 and 10, and one 6 years old sister. Apparently, her mother started having a bunch of kids after she remarried.

She's very caring, which can be seen even while she's in superhero mode.[/spoiler]

[From the in-game description]
